_comment: The playground's model services: the ONE file to edit to add one. Each entry: id (unique), label, type (stt | tts), url (the base of an OpenAI-compatible API, up to /v1), models, and for tts voices. api is openai (the default: STT on POST {url}/audio/transcriptions, TTS on POST {url}/audio/speech) or mimo (Xiaomi MiMo: TTS on POST {url}/chat/completions, the text as an assistant message, audio {format, voice}). auth, for a service that needs a key: the header that carries it, an optional prefix ("Bearer "), and the file the key is read from on every request, a Secret mounted by deployment.yaml; the key never leaves the server. A service whose key file is missing or empty is listed as unavailable. A new in-cluster service in namespace speech needs only this file; an external one also needs its host in networkpolicy.yaml, and its key a Secret mounted in deployment.yaml.
